reviewedArtifact.scope: Scanned title and approval pages, abstract, contents, list of tables, list of figures and appendix-figure captions. The 15-page attachment does not include the results tables or full methods/results chapters.

abstractFindings.seasonWording: The abstract says the aggregates were identified in the Timalan River Watershed during wet and dry season; it does not assign taxa to a season or sampling site.
abstractFindings.waterQualityAndSafetyUse: Not adopted as current conditions or a safety conclusion; the reviewed artifact supplies abstract-level historical context only.

watershedSiteFigure.description: Figure 13 is listed as showing nine water-sampling sites in the Timalan River Watershed.

samplingSiteTable.description: Table 2 is listed as the sampling sites for fish/crustacean identification and on-site water-quality assessment.

fishSpeciesTable.description: Table 3 is listed as fish species identified in the watershed during wet and dry season.

crustaceanSpeciesTable.description: Table 4 is listed as crustacean species identified in the watershed during wet and dry season.

stationInterpretation: These are names transcribed from appendix-figure captions in the accessible contents scan. The captions provide no coordinates, routes, or fish taxon assignments and are not used to create nine separate waterbody records or geometry.

accessAndReuse.officialLibraryAccessProcedure: CvSU Online Library Services directs users to search the thesis in its E-Library, submit the thesis abstract request form, and wait for library staff to email an available abstract. The online printed-book delivery program is limited to enrolled CvSU students, faculty, and staff; its stated scan limit is 5-10 pages. Eligibility for this independent project was not verified.
accessAndReuse.nextRetrievalTarget: Seek an authorized route to the full thesis or results pages containing Tables 2-4 (thesis pages 38, 43 and 58), Figure 13 (page 36), and the relevant station appendix. Confirm eligibility, species identifications, station/taxon and season/taxon crosswalks, and item-specific reuse before recording species assertions.

limitations: The study scope is a watershed containing multiple named rivers; the aggregate of 26 fish cannot be converted into species rows for the main Timalan River or any one tributary.
The accessible abstract/contents scan omits the taxa tables, full methods and results, station map, exact coordinates, vouchers and site/season assignments.
The abstract says identification used local fishermen, FishBase and online literature; this review did not verify field identifications or independently audit taxonomy.
The title-page and catalog dates conflict by one month and are preserved as reported.
The catalog abstract spells one locality feature as Timalan Baisahan River 2, while the appendix-figure caption scan reads Timalan Balsahan River 2; the name variant is unresolved.
The historical water-quality summary is not current water-quality or safety evidence.
The Timalan names in appendix captions do not establish the identity or course of every named river, a watershed boundary, or a legal fishing boundary.
The accessible scan's availability does not establish a license to reproduce its contents or underlying species table.
